title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode8 What We Can Do For Now

meta.Episode: Episode8 — What We Can Do For Now
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The sea's so beautiful and calm at night. There are so many stars out tonight too...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
They really are beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I overheard a part of the conversation you just had with that actress.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You two seemed to be having so much fun together, so I got a little curious... I apologize for eavesdropping like that.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay. You don't need to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Her stories were so interesting, weren't they? Visiting all those places, performing shows everywhere and meeting so many different people...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It must be a lot of fun being able to do shows like that.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Which is why leaving them was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But if it means making my dreams come true...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Are you wondering if you have to leave your friends someday to make your dreams come true?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After listening to Ms. Kazamatsuri's stories, I'm wondering if I'll have to make that same choice one day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I can't see myself leaving everyone to pursue a different goal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I convinced myself somewhere along the way that we'll keep doing this forever or something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was a hard pill to swallow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have our own dreams that we want to come true and work hard every day to make them happen.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we inevitably might have to go our separate ways someday...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I see. You may have no choice if you're all pursuing different dreams...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry...
I can't say for sure what would be best for you, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, please, don't apologize.
It's my fault for bringing this up...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I want you to be the one to figure out what's truly best for you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And I'll do whatever I can to help you find that answer.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't have to do this alone.
That's what she wanted me to know.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you guys still doing here? I thought you were heading back to the hotel once you finished cleaning up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. We have some good news, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the advance tickets for Phoenix Wonderland we came here to promote just sold out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! It's only natural considering how great our performances were! Hah hah hah!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To celebrate us taking our first big steps as ambassadors, we were thinking about doing this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu found a shop nearby that was selling them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to head back home tomorrow, so this is really our only chance to do something like this!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't have a problem with Sparkle-sparkle, Emu, but no BOOM, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Agreed.
No need to put ourselves in harm's way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really, Rui? You of all people...?
Anyway, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, it's time for some fireworks!!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Fireworks are no match for Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, what are you doing?! Don't run towards me! I'm downwind from you... *Cough*... Hack...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those two seem like they're enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Nene, what did you talk about with her...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... We talked about a lot of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like what happened behind the scenes while she was performing overseas and how hard she had to work to get where she is today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you had a nice chat with her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I started wondering about the future while I was talking to her. About us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm less clear about what I want to do moving forward compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Our future...
That's quite a lot to think about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since we each have our own dreams and goals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I plan on figuring out what's truly best for me and what I really want to do on my own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought this while you were improvising today, but you've come quite a long way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
I'm not a little kid, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I see your point...
What's truly best for Nene Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you ever need any help, feel free to ask me. I'll help you find the right answer in whatever way I can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For starters...
I'll give you the best answer I can think of right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We should enjoy this moment and have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui, look!
This one's really big!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, that's not a sparkler!
You're supposed to shoot that one into the air!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! Lemme try that!
Hm...? It won't light...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is a perfect opportunity to test out Robo-Nene's new gadget!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?
You didn't make it so she can start fires, did you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did. I've dubbed it the Robo-Nene Firestarter! Or more simply, a flamethrower that comes out of Robo-Nene's mouth...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are you serious?!
You have to disable it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Haha. I was just kidding.
I'll just use the spare lighter in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a spectacle worthy of a star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa could have fireworks attached to his back... No, it may be easier to launch him by packing him with the fireworks...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They seem to be having quite a bit of fun, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As we really start pursuing our own dreams, we may have to make some tough decisions...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's why I need to enjoy these moments as much as I can for now...)
